_doc: Music supervisor's decision record for the Down With Hunger explainer (2026-10-31). Every number comes from a command run in this pass (arrange.py with out/audio-review/music/arc.json, earshot timeline, a per-bar band/chord table and an onset-vs-grid check on the solo render). Edit: audio/design/music.json.

choice.title: Onion Capers
choice.author: Kevin MacLeod
choice.license: CC BY 4.0 (credit required; attribution string in manifests/music.json)
reasons: Tempo: 105.0016 BPM, grid residual 3.2 ms, 100 % of beats on the grid; stretch to 104 BPM = ratio 0.99046 (about 1 %, Rubber Band), the smallest of all candidates.

Downbeat phase confidence 1.06 (phase 1; scores [-0.61, 0.99, -0.32, -0.06]); the per-bar chord table changes chord exactly on these bar lines (4-bar F G C F phrases, B sections Bb F Bb F Bb F G C), and onsets sit on the beat grid within about 10 ms (estimator bias) through the track.

Key C major (analyze r 0.898), bouncy piano / tuba / pizzicato / light percussion: matches the brief's major-key playful sitcom feel; earshot match z +4.3 'strong' (#1), realness 0.94 'real or pro-produced'.
Clean master: 320 kbps, full bandwidth, peak -1.29 dBFS, 0 clipped samples.
134.9 s long with clear 8-bar form A1 0-7 | B1 8-15 | A2 16-23 | B2 24-31 | A3 32-39 | B3 40-47 | A4 48-55 | button: the 60.5-bar film needs only one 4-bar repeat.
A real button ending: the track stops after beat 3 of bar 55 and hits on the and-of-4 (attack 128.566 s, +39 dB over the bed), then rings to silence.

Weakness accepted: the arrangement is flat (LRA 2.4 LU, bars within about 3 dB). The arc is built from segment choice (the light A1 bars, -21 LUFS section, for the cold open and the breakdown; the loudest B section, B2, first heard at the drop) plus segment gain and the lead's VO ducking.

runner_up.title: Upbeat Jazz
runner_up.author: Francisco Alvear
runner_up.license: Mixkit Stock Music Free License (no Content ID registration)
why_not_first: Best built-in arc (sparse intro bars 1-3 at -16 dB rel, build 4-8, full-band entry at bar 9 with a +13 dB rise: a natural drop), but:
downbeat phase confidence 0.07 (LOW), another phase wins locally 52.4-69.8 s: bar lines unverified;
hot master -11.65 LUFS, peak +0.03 dBFS, 13 clipped samples (a run at 58.76 s), encoder shelf at 16 kHz;
only 110.2 s (about 116.6 s after stretch): about 9 bars of the full-band section would repeat;

the per-bar chord table reads mostly F minor / Bb minor (blues colour; analyze F major r 0.632 vs F minor 0.617) against the brief's major key, and the mix is bass-heavy (low band about 5 dB more dominant than Onion Capers).

grid.pickup: the track opens with a 1-beat pickup at src 0.30 s (before bar 0); it falls before film 0 and is not used
grid.verified_on_solo: film bar lines 1..57 measured on out/audio-review/music/solo_nobus.wav: attacks -4..+6 ms from n*2.30769 s (one -13 ms at bar 33, a swung pickup); median over all beats +2.4 ms (IQR 1.2..3.6 ms). No nudge of 'at' needed.

drop.decision: on the picture grid: film bar 20 = 46.154 s, not 45.89
drop.why: keeps every splice and every later wipe on the music's half-bar; the track's own swung and-of-4 anticipation before the B2 downbeat sounds at 45.86 s (earshot onset, emphasised by the lead's ride to -3 at 45.86), i.e. on the pot burst 45.895 and l11, and the downbeat follows 264 ms later, 61-65 ms before the protester stamp 46.215. Landing the downbeat at 45.89 would put every later bar line 264 ms off the picture grid.

button.note: separate segment off the grid on purpose: the track's own stop (music silent from 133.2 s, under the end of l25 which ends 133.83) is lengthened to 1.35 s, then the button lands on the slam with l26; rings to -58 dB RMS by 136.0 and silence by 139.0.

levels_music_only_short_term_LUFS._doc: solo render without the bus rides (out/audio-review/music/solo_nobus.wav), music.gain_db +7

qa: qa.py --only music: clicks 0, edges 0 defects; one craft note (1.1 s of no music before 134.528 = the deliberate stop-time, carries qa_ok).
risks: CC BY Kevin MacLeod tracks are widely used: Content ID claims are possible; dispute citing the CC BY 4.0 licence and the credit.

The lead's duck (-10 dB from 131.185 to 135.28 under l26) sits on the button: it plays at -25 LUFS short-term and the duck release 135.28-135.78 lifts its ring by up to 10 dB. Suggest the lead ride l26 like the title (about -3 dB from 134.45) so the button lands.
The rebuild entry at 36.92 s reads as a strong accent (+18 dB over the breakdown bed with the rides) 0.76 s before the 37.68 iris swish.
